descriptionBody: The South Fork segment extends between the junction of FR 85 and FR 285 (Water Canyon Road) near Eagar and the junction of FR 409 and SR 273 on the Big Lake–Greer plateau in the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forests. The alignment crosses high meadows and mixed conifer forest of the Springerville Volcanic Field, skirting the South Fork Little Colorado River country and trending toward the Big Lake/Greer lakes region. Notable points of interest along or near the corridor include Saffel Canyon OHV Trailhead, a 50" only trail just off Water Canyon Road, scenic meadow overlooks along FR 409, and easy access to the Big Lake recreation complex via the 273 corridor.

This segment consists primarily of unpaved forest roads and OHV connectors with surfaces ranging from graded dirt to rocky two-track, with seasonal ruts and washboards, especially after monsoon storms or spring melt. High-clearance 4WD/OHV is recommended.
amenitiesNote: Concentrated in Eagar/Springerville (fuel, food, lodging, medical, and OHV services) at the eastern access via Water Canyon Road. Near the western end, the Big Lake Recreation Area offers multiple campgrounds, boat ramps, and seasonal concessions, while Greer provides cabins, dining, and lodging a short drive north of the FR 273 corridor. Dispersed camping is common on and around FR 409 where permitted.

seo.title: South Fork — Arizona Alpine Trail Segment 18
seo.description: 22.0 miles across the Big Lake–Greer plateau near Springerville. More Difficult/Blue rated, high-clearance 4WD/OHV recommended.
